entities.summary: Leo Brent Bozell III is an American conservative activist, writer and diplomat. Bozell is the founder of the Media Research Center, an organization whose purpose is to document and combat alleged media bias. In 2025, Bozell was nominated by President Donald Trump to be the next United States Ambassador to South Africa. The United States Senate confirmed Bozell's nomination on December 18, 2025, by a party-line vote of 53-43.
